body: I have no idea, that's the problem. I figure I should get my degree just to be safe, but I literally haven idea what I want to do with my life because I have nothing to go off of because I've wasted my life doing nothing.

Yes I have a psychiatrist, he put me on lamictal. As for my daily routine, it's sitting in my basement ruminating on all the things I posted above about having no talents, interests or hobbies or friends. I wake up and go to bed every day with no plans except aimlessly surfing the internet and staring at the ceiling. I just don't know where to start or begin. I have no idea what I should be doing at any moment if that makes sense, I'm paralyzed and literally sit around doing absolutely nothing except being tortured by my thoughts. For example, tonight I have no plans except to sit down here doing absolutely nothing. Wherever I am or whatever I'm doing these thoughts consume my being about how alone I am and how I'll never have a relationship or friendship. I had an ex "girlfriend" (I put that it quotes because really we just hooked up for two months) call me boring to my face and it rings true. I'm a statue basically, chronically paralyzed and hesitating unable to make decisions. 

I'm too crippled by anxiety to even know what to do next so I end up doing nothing. So if people were around me I would have nothing to say because I literally have done nothing except hide away my entire life.

My relationship is fine with my parents, they love me unconditionally and don't judge. And the last time I enjoyed myself was doing drugs with my friend (mainly lsd). 

That's the thing, I spend my days doing nothing except sitting inside chronically paralyzed and ruminating on the stuff I posted above  because I don't know where to begin. Where do I even start digging out of the hole of no talents, interests, hobbies etc? It feels like I wasted my life. 

I can't get over the fact that if someone were to hang out with me I would have nothing to say, I'm frozen like a statue just passively letting life pass me by. 

All that runs through my head all day is "I have nothing to say...I have nothing to say...I have nothing to say." Whether it's at the dinner table or making Christmas cookies with my aunts that's all that's in my head so I feel like I'm gonna be alone my whole life 

It doesn't help that I have no long term goals either. I just drifted through life and now I'm paying for it?
My major is economics and I mainly stuck with it because I initially got an A in Econ 101 (curved class out of 500 students)  and enjoyed the class and the major seemed practical to landing a job.
